about: Still Blue unified dataset of NASA PSI microgravity combustion tests. Every number here was computed by code from data/processed/.

rules_of_the_data.partial_gravity: PSI holds 0 partial-gravity combustion tests in this dataset. All tests are microgravity.
rules_of_the_data.phases: Gas, liquid and solid tests are never summed or compared as one population.
rules_of_the_data.gas_burners: CFI-G and Flame Design are gas flames on burners, not habitat materials.
rules_of_the_data.log_labels: Outcome labels derived from logs are 'not sustained', a Still Blue rule, not the researcher's label.

Observe the flames with a broad suite of cameras, radiometers, photomultiplier [...]

definition.population: tests with oxidizer_location = ambient and chamber O2 reported; inverse flames (burner-stream O2) excluded
definition.box: within 2 O2 points and 10 kPa of the target
definition.scaled_distance: sqrt((dO2 points / 2)^2 + (dP kPa / 10)^2); 1.0 is the corner of the box. Scales are declared, not fitted
definition.note: Tests without a reported pressure enter the O2-only gap but not the pressure gap, the box or the scaled distance.

definition.method: Spearman rho; 95% percentile bootstrap, 10000 resamples of tests, seed 20261115
definition.criterion: rho > 0 with the interval excluding zero

end_of_test_kind_meaning.fall_at_steady_fan: radiometer signal fell while the fan setting was steady
end_of_test_kind_meaning.fall_after_fan_step_up: radiometer signal fell after the fan was stepped up
end_of_test_kind_meaning.video_ends_before_fall: recording ends before any fall of the radiometer signal
end_of_test_kind_meaning.no_fall_detected: no fall of the radiometer signal detected

flow_speed_when_signal_fell.population: video_accepted = true and end_of_test_kind = fall_at_steady_fan, flow_at_rad_decay_cm_s not null
flow_speed_when_signal_fell.caveat: Descriptive medians of the flow speed when the radiometer signal started to fall. Not a quenching or flammability boundary.

rule_validation_cfig.reading: The script detects that the flame is gone; it cannot tell a failed ignition from a self-extinction, hence 'not_sustained'. The log window starts at the ignition command, so it is longer than the PI burn time.
